note: O'Brien County's maps page lists no zoning layer or service. Sheldon, the county's largest city, publishes its zoning map and ordinance only as PDF (sheldoniowa.gov/documents). No official queryable zoning service found. An ISU-hosted statewide zoning compilation (zoning_districts_all_data_v2, Sheldon fips7 1972390) has 8 Sheldon districts, but it is an unofficial copy and 6 of 8 polygons fail validity, so it was not submitted.
